content:
maya: quick share — did a warm-start quant-profile sweep for argo-14b on H100 vs A100 across us-east-1 and eu-west-1. posting top-level numbers and a short note; full CSV uploaded to GCS.
kevin: awesome, do you have p50/p95 and a quality delta for each qprofile?
maya: yep. all runs seq=1024, batch=2, 50 warmup iters, 300 measured iters. quality delta = relative avg accuracy on eval set (higher is better). H100 numbers first:
maya: H100 us-east-1 (fp16 baseline) — p50 78ms, p95 158ms, throughput 235 tok/s
maya: H100 us-east-1 (fp8-qprof-5) — p50 36ms, p95 82ms, throughput 520 tok/s, quality delta -0.18%
maya: H100 us-east-1 (int8-qprof-3) — p50 28ms, p95 66ms, throughput 670 tok/s, quality delta -0.95%
maya: H100 eu-west-1 (fp16 baseline) — p50 92ms, p95 190ms, throughput 200 tok/s
maya: H100 eu-west-1 (fp8-qprof-5) — p50 42ms, p95 94ms, throughput 460 tok/s, quality delta -0.23%
maya: H100 eu-west-1 (int8-qprof-3) — p50 34ms, p95 78ms, throughput 590 tok/s, quality delta -1.1%
maya: A100 us-east-1 (fp16 baseline) — p50 112ms, p95 245ms, throughput 160 tok/s
maya: A100 us-east-1 (fp8-qprof-5) — p50 58ms, p95 132ms, throughput 300 tok/s, quality delta -0.6%
maya: A100 us-east-1 (int8-qprof-3) — p50 48ms, p95 110ms, throughput 370 tok/s, quality delta -1.4%
maya: A100 eu-west-1 (fp16 baseline) — p50 130ms, p95 270ms, throughput 140 tok/s
maya: A100 eu-west-1 (fp8-qprof-5) — p50 66ms, p95 150ms, throughput 260 tok/s, quality delta -0.85%
maya: A100 eu-west-1 (int8-qprof-3) — p50 54ms, p95 126ms, throughput 320 tok/s, quality delta -1.7%
olivia: thanks — small note on quality: the eval set includes dialogue and code samples; int8 regresses more on code completion snippets (more token-level hallucinations). fp8 looks much safer overall.
kevin: interesting. what kernels did you use? cutlass, cuBLAS, or our packed kernels?
maya: tested two kernel stacks: (1) cutlass-optimized GEMM + fused attention (our default for H100), (2) packed-kernel (experimental) which we used for the int8 path. packed-kernel gives ~8-12% extra throughput for int8 on H100, but stability on A100 is still hit-or-miss.
sam: for capacity sizing: using p95 numbers, rough client qps per instance (seq1024): H100 int8 -> ~590 tok/s => ~0.58 req/s if average request 1024 tokens? (depends on tokens/req). we used 512-token requests in production sims so adjust accordingly.
kevin: can you paste the run command you used? will rerun with a different prompt mix.
maya: run used for automation:

```bash
./bench_runner --model argo-14b --quant qprof-3 --gpu h100 --region us-east-1 \
  --seq 1024 --batch 2 --warmup 50 --iters 300 --kernels packed-kernel --out=result_us_h100_q3.csv
```

kevin: perfect. will try same with cutlass on int8 and compare.
olivia: also note we flagged 12 prompts where int8 produced <acceptable threshold responses. i attached examples in the CSV with diff highlights.
maya: tl;dr recommendations:
- H100: use int8-qprof-3 + packed-kernel for high-throughput non-critical workloads (2.5-3x speedup, ~1% quality loss). fp8-qprof-5 for balanced latency/quality (2.0x, ~0.2% loss).
- A100: prefer fp8-qprof-5 for most workloads (1.8x, small quality impact). int8 gives bigger speedups but quality hit is larger and kernel stability risk.
- Regions: eu-west shows ~10-15% higher baseline latency vs us-east; that compresses relative speedups a bit.

sam: noted. for Dedicated sizing I'll use p95 fp8 numbers for A100 and int8 p95 for H100 as two sizing scenarios.
kevin: any concerns about rollout? canary on 5% traffic with fp8 then expand, keep int8 behind opt-in.
maya: agree. canary + eval hooks (olivia's checkers) + automatic rollback on eval regression >0.5%.
bench-bot: summary uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/argo14b/1769501234/ — CSV + raw logs + kernel traces.
olivia: nice, i'll run the eval harness overnight against the full prompt corpus and report back tomorrow.
maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
